domain_info: The input is short stock video collected for Humain's Saudi-tourism cultural-understanding work and organized into Lifestyle, Landmarks / Architecture, Events, Clothing / Fashion, and Food source themes. Treat those themes as source organization, not guaranteed ground truth. Describe only observable visual and audible evidence. Do not infer a person's nationality, ethnicity, religion, or identity from appearance. Identify Saudi Arabia or a specific place, event, food, symbol, or cultural practice only when supported by explicit evidence such as a recognizable landmark, flag, legible signage, spoken words, or a distinctive documented feature; otherwise use appropriately uncertain Gulf, Arab-region, or generic wording. Capture Arabic and English speech/OCR, visible place names, architecture, indoor/outdoor setting, urban/rural context, activity, food preparation and dining, clothing and accessories without identity assumptions, event indicators, people/group composition, time of day, weather, camera framing, and technical quality. Distinguish modern from traditional elements only when visually supported. Call out ambiguity rather than guessing.
